cD x * 1 + cD (y / x) * (y * -(x ^ 2)⁻¹) - cD ((1 - x) * y / ((1 - y) * x)) * (- -(x ^ 2)⁻¹ / (1 - y⁻¹)) + cD ((1 - x) / (1 - y)) * (-1 / (1 - y)) = 0
